text.en:
Organization and Membership. There shall be an organization of all the members of the
Sangguniang Panlalawigan and Sangguniang Panlungsod to be established in each of the twelve (12) regions
of the country, which shall hereinafter be known as the Pampook na Katipunan ng mga Sanggunian.
In addition thereto, Metropolitan Manila shall be treated as one region, and all the members of the
Sangguniang Panlungsod and Sangguniang Pambayan therein shall comprise the Pampook na Katipunan ng
mga Sanggunian in such region notwithstanding the provisions of Section 1 of Presidential Decree No. 877.
The presiding officers (governors and mayors) of the Sangguniang Bayans mentioned in the two preceding
paragraph shall also be included as members of their respective Pampook na Katipunan ng mga Sanggunian.

Annual Conference. The Pampook na Katipunan ng mga Sanggunian shall meet in conference at
least once a year on a date set by its Executive Committee, or at the call of the President of the Philippines;

Officers. The Pampook na Katipunan ng mga Sanggunian shall elect a temporary chairman and
such other officers as may be necessary at the start of the conference, whose terms of office shall extend only
for the duration of such conference. The chairman shall be the presiding officer of the meetings of the
Pampook na Katipunan ng mga Sanggunian for the duration of its conference.

Executive Committee. There shall be an Executive Committee to be elected by and among the
members of the Pampook na Katipunan ng mga Sanggunian, which shall be authorized to act for and in behalf
of the Pampook na Katipunan ng mga Sanggunian when not in session.
The Executive Committee shall be composed of seven (7) members, to wit:
one governor or mayor;
one barangay federation president;
one kabataang barangay federation president; and
four sectoral representatives.

Regional Secretariat. The Pampook na Katipunan ng mga Sanggunian in each of the regions

stated in Section 1 hereof shall have a permanent secretariat, the staff support of which shall be provided by
the Department of Local Government and Community Development.

Repealing Clause. All laws or parts of law, as well as all executive orders, or regulations,
inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.

Date of Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
